parts.text: This question is about elements in different groups of the Periodic Table and their compounds.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Nitrogen is in Group V of the Periodic Table. Explain why nitrogen is placed in Group V. Give your answer in terms of electronic configuration. ............................................................................................................................................. [1]

ms.label: 5(a)
ms.text: it has 5 electrons in its outer electron shell

ms.label: 5(b)
ms.text:
liquid (1)
between melting and boiling point (1)

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) When a sample of sodium is added to a large container of cold water, a chemical reaction occurs.

ms.text:
any 3 from:

moves

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Complete the word equation for the reaction of sodium with water. sodium + water ....................... ....................... + hydrogen [1]

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Sodium carbonate reacts with sulfuric acid to form sodium sulfate, carbon dioxide and one other product. Complete the symbol equation for this reaction. Na 2 CO 3 + .................... Na 2 SO 4 + CO 2 + .................... [2]

parts.text: (f) Solid sodium hydroxide is slowly added to distilled water containing a few drops of thymolphthalein and the mixture is stirred.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) State the colour change observed when sodium hydroxide is added to water containing thymolphthalein. from ............................................................. to ............................................................. [2]

parts.text: (g) Fluorine is in Group VII of the Periodic Table. Fluorine reacts with sodium to form the ionic compound sodium fluoride. Complete the dot-and-cross diagram in Fig. 5.1 for sodium fluoride to show: • the electronic configuration for each ion • the charge on each ion. Fig. 5.1 [3]
